investigation_notes.Alert Name: Trend Micro: Malware Detected on Endpoint
investigation_notes.Description: A software crack/keygen was detected in a user-accessible Downloads directory. The file MS Office Activator (Crack).exe was flagged as CRCK_KEYGEN by Trend Micro Real-time Scan. Quarantine failed to constrain the file, indicating the threat may still be present in the environment and warrants further investigation. The activity involves an admin local user account, which elevates potential risk and requires validation of legitimacy.
